title: Generate a timestamped log with separate error output
prompt:
Generate a timestamped log with separate error output.

Use a disposable practice directory and synthetic inputs. Submit your Bash script and a short verification note. CodeLeaf does not run Bash submissions inside its web process, so this exercise uses a server-side text gate plus the acceptance criteria below; complete technical correctness requires manual review or an isolated local test environment.

starter.execution_mode: manual-terminal; requires a local Bash interpreter or a separately isolated runner

public_tests.name: Required concept present
public_tests.note: Text gate looks for a relevant Bash pattern (>&2); it is not proof the script runs correctly.

public_tests.name: Acceptance checklist
public_tests.note: Review output, status, invalid input, safety, and boundary cases in an isolated environment.

acceptance_criteria: Implements the requested behavior for Redirection, logging.
Quotes expansions and preserves filenames/argument boundaries where relevant.
Handles at least one invalid-input or failure case and documents the expected status/output.
Includes a safe way to test the script with disposable or synthetic inputs.
hints: Start with the smallest successful input.
Add an edge case before adding options or extra features.
Use bash -n script.sh for a syntax-only check, then test manually in a disposable directory.

retry_policy.guidance: Revise and resubmit after inspecting the feedback. The platform’s server owns the one-time base reward; the course does not override XP.

expected_output: A reviewable Bash script plus a reproducible test note showing normal and failure-path behavior.
status_note: Draft exercise derived from Bash.pdf Section C. The text grader is a lightweight gate only; publish after technical and grading review.
